p: Original dark fantasy game sprite production sheet of reference character 06 SHADOW PIRATE DUAL PISTOL GUNNER: brown-black tricorn skull hat, red bandana tails, skull print cloth face mask, black long coat with burgundy-red lining, brown belts and brass buckles, dark trousers and tall brown boots, TWO flintlock pistols, sparse thin dark red supernatural wisps. Preserve reference identity and painterly sprite style. EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 independent poses. Equal cells with FULL figures and all pistol barrels inside each cell, generous clear 15% transparent whitespace all sides INSIDE EVERY cell. Small characters occupy at most 65% cell height; all feet on same relative baseline. TRUE transparent alpha; no checkerboard, text, grid, background, dirt, ground shadow, broad pale halos or bullets outside cells. Animation row1=4 DISTINCT alternating walk cycle steps (left foot planted/right foot passing, right stride, right foot planted/left passing, left stride). Row2=4 sequential dual pistol attack phases: both guns raise/aim; first hand firing orange muzzle flash; opposite hand firing muzzle flash and first recoil; both lower into recovery. Keep muzzle flashes compact, no long red projectile trails. Row3=cast2 then hurt2: gather crimson arcane wisps with pistols raised; release small crimson magical ring; backward recoil with small orange impact spark; low guard recovery. Pistols are SHORT flintlock handguns, never a rifle or sword. Maintain character height and body proportions throughout. ALL 12 FRONT three-quarter poses with mask/eyes visible, actor centered.
